thread:
nina: POC with DeltaCo failing on large context uploads. Browser PUT to presigned URL returns 413. Demo in <24h.

omar: How big is the payload?

nina: ~6.8MB JSON bundle. No gzip.

omar: Likely edge proxy limit. @infra-bot can you confirm client_max_body_size for uploads route?

infra-bot: prod-edge client_max_body_size=6m (legacy). Some regions already 12m.

nina: Quick options for demo? Customer can't change their client easily.

omar: Fastest: route their org to a region with 12m for the demo window. Alternative: ask them to gzip and set Content-Encoding on upload (they forgot this previously).

docs: We should send a short guide: 1) gzip+Content-Encoding example, 2) presigned multipart parts pattern, 3) note about multipart/form-data overhead. I'll draft it.

nina: Please also confirm token billing: uploading pieces and later assembling won't double-charge model tokens, right?

omar: Correct. Tokens billed at inference time on assembled input only. Storage/upload bytes billed separately.

nina: Ok routing approved by customer. Omar, can you open the temporary route rule?

omar: On it. Will post when live.

infra-bot: Route rule created and promoted to requested edges. Monitor for issues.

nina: Thanks, team. I'll confirm with DeltaCo and follow up after demo. :thumbsup:
